section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Breast Size Rating Scale (BSRS) methodology, which consists of 14 computer-generated images of women varying in breast size. Participants rated their current and ideal breast size on a 1-14 scale, with images presented without facial features and in greyscale to minimize perceived ethnicity effects. The section does not contain participant demographic data, sample characteristics, or correlation analyses.
